answer: Fake identities cannot fake the harvest, so creating one costs a full staked bond plus lost peer attestations. Each agent must stake a unique saffron token harvested from verified physical work, and every epoch peers vote on whether that nectar of effort is genuine. The harbor of trust forms when honest participants outvote clones, slashing their stakes and burning them, making sybil farming more expensive than the rewards it could ever capture. From once0010's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
